verdict.rationale: Alacritty documents font tuning: family, style and point size per face, plus x/y offset for letter and line spacing, and a built-in font for box-drawing characters. However, community reports say ligatures are a long-standing unsupported feature that drove users to Kitty and WezTerm, and the pack has no evidence of configurable fallback fonts. Missing for 10: ligature support, configurable fallback font chains, deeper rendering controls (e.g. glyph offset, hinting/antialiasing options) beyond basic size and spacing.
